body:
Raised 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles), post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1269, exact merge `7ef4b1c289688fa65be3be51c9c6c8991c48ee51`, reviewed head `bbe6c5cf4b9a7138dd9395c9c3126787aaf1d34c`. This is a new bounded preservation/integrity remainder after closed #1248; preserve that issue's completion history and one-PR budget, original #1173 and parent #446 evidence.

**Independently inspected defect; runtime reproduction remains unexecuted.** The complete merged `reproduce.py` is 4,493 bytes, SHA256 `107c20e0cb35ad47d614d56d11bc97780178e769d885bfd66bf0a7f96eba3265`. In `validate_capsule`, the expected executable-code identities come from `json.loads((HERE / "evidence-quality.json").read_text())["capsule"]`. The function iterates whichever entries this editable mapping provides. There is no independently anchored expected capsule hash or required capsule-entry inventory. The separate literal `PINNED` dictionary authenticates the nine original/source inputs but **does not include the actually executed `inputs/code/capsule-reproduce.py`**. `main` then unconditionally invokes that materialized file and only checks the resulting report against the historical report.

Deleting the executed capsule's entry from the manifest therefore removes its code check altogether. Editing the capsule and refreshing only its hash in the same editable manifest also makes this check self-authenticating. Neither action changes the nine original contract/input pins or the unchanged runner's bytes. Whole source/input hashing and equality with a historical report cannot authenticate the code that executes or exclude additional unreviewed effects. The retained source representation results are not shown wrong by this finding.

**Reproduction to execute in an admitted isolated managed checkout:** first perform the genuine documented runner twice into distinct fresh owned output names. For a directed complete-code fixture, preserve the exact original manifest/capsule, use only a fresh Auditor/worker-owned test packet and the complete immutable original inputs, append a harmless probe writing `audit-unreviewed-code.txt` in that fixture's own new output directory, and (a) remove `inputs/code/capsule-reproduce.py` from `manifest["capsule"]`, or (b) replace that entry with the hash of the complete altered capsule. Run the unchanged actual wrapper with `--output <fresh-owned-output>`. The inspected code path has no remaining independent executable identity check in either case. Record the actual exit status, report/probe presence and unchanged originals; do not label the predicted successful execution as already observed. Expected behavior is rejection **before executing altered code or creating a destination/probe**, regardless of removal or coherent refresh of untrusted local manifest fields.

The Auditor did not run this fixture or the producer: two storage checks failed below the 10 GiB floor, and a later allocation still refused headroom after an apparently passing check. No unmanaged execution fallback or original mutation was used. This report is based on complete static code/control-flow and whole-byte custody inspection, not an alleged observed exploit or an institution/source authenticity finding.

**Completed inspection to preserve:** all 21 changed head/merge blobs and modes agree (36,009,569 bytes); all 29 manifest descriptors authenticate complete actual bytes; all nine original baseline objects/modes remain unchanged at the merge. All four retained complete 2,506-byte reports equal the original SHA256 `3970173b2c2050c1099ec427e4d64076e96a3000635ba20db203fa204320e44a`. An independent join over the complete 19-feature geoBoundaries and 21-feature IGM payloads confirms the one exact Artigas subject and full reported IGM records 15/16 fields, including the distinct retained observation spellings. Original/capsule baseline literal pin values and exact 21 change receipts agree. The complete unique raw object scope inspected is 36,016,388 bytes, largest 16,950,115 bytes; add all actual new code/control/output bytes and a real reserve while preserving existing 32 MiB object / 256 MiB phase / 512 descriptor limits.

**Success criteria: one additive source-only geography evidence PR under the new disjoint prefix below.**
- Preserve every original #1173/#1269 packet, source, script, manifest, report, date, exact ID and geometry. Do not replace old reports or silently change historical code. Retain all five baseline inputs, both complete source payloads, the original report and complete source inventory/restoration instructions.
- Provide a documented offline wrapper whose required actually executed project code is anchored to independently reviewed immutable whole bytes. Reject missing code-pin entries, altered complete capsule code with unchanged trusted pins, and coherent changes to untrusted local manifest/code. A candidate manifest cannot alone attest its own executable identity. Preserve meaningful existing wrong-input and duplicate-subject checks.
- Exercise actual entry points with two fresh genuine full runs equal to the original complete report, both directed manifest/code cases above, a missing required executable pin, ordinary isolated code drift, wrong complete input bytes, existing-output sentinel, broken symlink, symlink-parent escape and traversal. Admit fresh owned destinations before computation/creation; publish exclusively and preserve unique failed attempts without a valid success receipt.
- Retain complete actual inputs/code/runtime/process outcomes and immutable positive/negative evidence. Obtain distinct substantive exact-head implementation/source and any applicable geometry review, ordinary CI and serialized integration. No refreshed boolean can replace an unexecuted control or real code authentication.
- Keep the interpretation strictly representation/preservation: one Artigas subject and contested IGM IDs 15/16 are source contexts, not a territorial membership/title determination. Five legal originals remain restoration-only; no new source restoration/authentication, topology/area/overlay claim, sovereignty inference, geography/hierarchy edit, repair, import, publication or approval.

**Deduplication/ownership:** complete authenticated all-state inventory comprises 1,412 issue/PR entries in 15 pages (14×100 +12); complete current open-PR file pagination covers four PRs. No existing task/repair covers this Artigas capsule identity defect or overlaps the new prefix. #1237 and #1239 concern different producers, lanes/owned namespaces and defects; preserve their scope/owners. Fresh main `c01c74a17ac42502bdd1c088749974c14626bc10` still has the exact affected runner Git object. Dependency #1248 is closed and its canonical reservation is released; do not reopen it. No implementation claim is taken. Initially blocked pending fresh shared read-only readiness/ownership review.
